Jubilee.reason: Jubilee Line: Minor delays due to an earlier fire alert at Canons Park.

Mildmay.reason: MILDMAY LINE: Sunday 26 July, a reduced service will run between Shepherds Bush and Clapham Junction. Trains will use platform 17 at Clapham Junction and will run an uneven service every 15/30 minutes, with additional Southern Railway services. Southern Railway services will terminate at Shepherd's Bush until 1200. Please note that on this day, there will be no step-free access via the Grant Road entrance, please use the Brighton Yard entrance instead.

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Minor delays due to an earlier points failure at Brixton.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.

Windrush.reason: WINDRUSH LINE: Sunday 26 July, no service between Wandsworth Road and Clapham Junction. Trains will divert to/from Battersea Park after Wandsworth Road. Use local buses via any reasonable route between Clapham Junction and Battersea Park / Surrey Quays or Southern trains between Battersea Park and Clapham Junction, where tickets will be accepted. In addition, the early Sunday morning train at 0001 from Highbury & Islington to Battersea Park will not run.
